candidates: Before removing an export from a shared infrastructure module (e.g. `preview/globals`, `manager/globals`, or any `definitions`/`globals` barrel), verify the export is not imported anywhere in the monorepo—including builder packages and other lib packages—and confirm with teammates that no in-progress work depends on it; if uncertain, keep the export and add a TODO comment rather than deleting it.

When migrating addon `package.json` entries from `peerDependencies` to `devDependencies`, audit each package's actual import usage in the addon's source files before including it as a devDependency; do not mechanically carry over every previous peer dep—remove packages (e.g. `react-dom`) that are not directly imported by the addon's own source.
